note: Jams.SectorOn with ledger_paying (Sym/Chill.lean 49-95) fixes the listing for the whole line, and the coupling enters only through the Gaussian rescaling, with Fold.unveils giving the exponential scaling.

snippet.text:
structure SectorOn (V:sun→ Chord.Flight A N m n)(Y:Mist A.B.a m (fire G (D.L (A.B.a.clock.J (m+1))) (A.B.a.clock.hatBeta m)) (thaw G (D.L (A.B.a.clock.J (m+1))) (A.B.a.clock.hatBeta m))) : Prop where
  pays (t:sun) : (V t|>.val.beta)=(Y.peak t).val
  layout i j:listIn (V i).val=listIn (V j).val
  lineE : ∀ x i,∃ (f:ℝ→ℝ), FullVolume.Ray.ink 2 f ∧∀ t:sun,f t=(V t).val.activities.regularOccurrence (V t).val.p i x
  lineK : ∀ x i,∃ (f:ℝ→ℝ), FullVolume.Ray.ink 2 f ∧∀ t:sun,f t=(V t).val.activities.K i x

proof_context.conclusion: SectorOn requires one listing of activities along the whole line and that the activities and kernels are smooth functions of the line parameter.

snippet.text:
lemma ledger_paying (i:sun): Chord.listing H (F i)=pluck B (Marlin.lodge (H.crewD V₀) e (2*e)) ∧ Chord.source H (F i) = Marlin.poursP B (Marlin.lodge (H.crewD V₀) e (2*e)) (donation Pz D' B Q' γ p e i):=by
  have hr:= sight_thaw H hV i; have hp:= offer_turn H hV i; rw [gatestone (A:=A) i] at hr hp; unfold Chord.listing Chord.source Chord.lens; rw [hp,hr]; exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩

proof_context.conclusion: ledger_paying shows the listing and source of each element of the line equal the common lodge-based values, independent of the line parameter.

snippet.text:
lemma unveils (q:ℝ): Scout R (fun s=> Real.exp (h.sqcost s*q)) (Real.exp (h.scaleT q)):=by
  let a:= h.peak; let d:= h.slope; let v:= (1-a^2)*q; let w₁:=-(2*a*d)*q; let w₂:=-(d^2)*q
  let t(s:ℝ):=w₁*s+w₂*s^2; have he:= Scout.line h.price
  have hp:= (he.scale w₁).pair ((he.power 2).scale w₂)
  have ht: Scout R t (‖w₁‖*R+‖w₂‖*R^2):=hp
  have hz:h.scaleT q=v+(‖w₁‖*R+‖w₂‖*R^2):= by
    unfold scaleT sqcost flow v w₁ w₂; simp only [neg_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_neg,abs_mul, mul_zero,add_zero]; unfold a d; rw [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg h.slope)] -- abs_pow
    ring
  rw [hz,Real.exp_add]
  have hi:= ht.ignite.scale (Real.exp v); rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _|>.le)] at hi
  refine hi.replace (fun s hs=>?_)
  dsimp only; rw [smul_eq_mul,← Real.exp_add]; unfold v t w₁ w₂ a d sqcost flow; ring_nf

proof_context.conclusion: unveils shows exp(sqcost s * q) is a Scout (a uniformly bounded smooth family) with scale exp(scaleT q), the Gaussian rescaling by the coupling.
